author: pokeaatrox
quote: After 13 years of hype, GTA 6 is a massive disappointment that fails to live up to expectations. First, the technical state of the game is unacceptable for a AAA release of this scale. On PS5, the game is riddled with bugs and suffers from constant FPS drops. Even worse, it repeatedly crashes the console, to the point where some systems won't even turn back on, as seen in countless reports flooding the r/PS5 and r/PS5HelpSupport subreddits. Second, the gameplay itself still feels clunky and overly heavy. While it's slightly better than GTA V, the character movement and controls remain sluggish and dated for a modern title. On top of that, several mechanics trying too hard to be "realistic" completely ruin the pacing, the overall experience, and the fun. To top it all off, Rockstar's release strategy feels anti-consumer. Launching without an Online mode after more than a decade of development is bad enough, but shipping the "physical" edition as an empty box with just a download code (no Blu-ray disc at all!) is the final straw. Between the severe hardware-threatening bugs, poor performance, heavy and overly "realistic" controls, missing Online mode, and the lack of a real physical disc, this is nowhere near the masterpiece people waited 13 years for.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: The remaster is bad. It's truly lazy at this level. A remaster during the PS5 generation with PS3 graphics. The game is still incredibly drawn out, especially episode 5, which is disrespectful to the player. The inability to skip cutscenes or even fast-forward is still painfully obvious. And worst of all, a narrative game with only English voice acting is yet another sign of disrespect towards non-English-speaking players. The prequel is better off watching a summary on YouTube and saving yourself a few hours of your time. The story, however, is good; finally, something dark and adult-oriented.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: Dropping the French voice-overs that made the original games so great is a terrible decision by IO Interactive. I will not spend my hard-earned money on a triple-A game that forces me to read subtitles just to understand NPC dialogue. No French dub, no money. Simple as that.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: I have been a fan of this franchise for years, mostly because the older games treated French players with respect by providing fully dubbed experiences. Philippe Dumond's voice was iconic for Agent 47 in France. Seeing IO Interactive completely ditch localized voice-overs in their current games is heartbreaking. Subtitles are not enough for a game where you need to constantly listen to background conversations for clues. If IO Interactive continues down this path with their future projects, they won't see my money ever again.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: It is incredibly frustrating to see a major studio abandon its French-speaking community. Older Hitman titles had full, high-quality French dubbing, but IO Interactive decided to cut corners for the newer releases. This is a terrible business decision. I will not support a developer that ignores its international player base. No French audio means no purchase from me.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: I am extremely disappointed with IO Interactive's decision to drop the French voice-over. Previous Hitman games always offered an excellent French dubbing that greatly contributed to the immersion. Removing this feature in the modern games is a huge step backward. I refuse to play a narrative-driven game without proper localization in my native language. Until French voice acting is brought back to IO's games, they will not get a single cent of my money.

If you're playing in co-op with others, you all end up in a mini pod with 2 crafting stations that you can only use one at a time. It's boring and the combat is TERRIBLE.

quote: The game isn't even offered in any language other than English. And this isn't even a AAA title, there's no voice acting, Square Enix isn't a small company, and they're using Unreal Engine, a third-party engine. It's truly shameful. Square Enix isn't what it used to be.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: The game is bad. The story is incredibly boring, the world is empty, and the NPCs barely move, if at all. We were promised perfect distant textures, but that was a lie. The water looks awful, and dirt kicks up from your feet even when you aren't walking on dirt.There are way too many buttons for no reason; it's just not justified. In other games, you can just press space to jump, but here, you have to aim before you can even jump. A lot of features are being hyped up (by sellout YouTubers) as 'insane' when they’ve actually existed in many other games for **** game is simply overrated. They managed to run a great marketing campaign, but the reality is that it’s a huge letdown. And to top it off: Denuvo was implemented at the last minute, which—once again—negatively impacts performance.

author: pokeaatrox
quote: The game is boring, artificially stretched out, lengthened solely to increase its lifespan, and very (too) linear. The gameplay is very clunky. 90% of the time you're not fighting infected but humans. Additions like the guitar are useless and unintuitive, and finally: Opinion is being abused. People can do what they want with their bodies, but making all the women short-haired, more muscular than most men, and almost all attracted to the same type just shows the pressure to conform to what they want us to believe is how it should be for everyone. Just because some people aren't respected for their sins doesn't mean everyone has to be the same. Lately, we hear a lot of people complaining about these imposed visions. I used to think these complainers were exaggerating. Now that I'm starting to play this kind of game, I realize that the exaggeration is on the developers' side, not the consumer's, who's fed up. My experience was ruined; the game doesn't deserve this press review. It's at best okay.
